name: Wealthfront OG social card — "Money works better here." by wealthfront.com
description: A 1200×630 social card built on a single deep violet field with a radial bloom behind the headline and one large curved sweep crossing the lower third for depth. Hierarchy is strict: small white wordmark top-left, a dominant two-line headline mixing an ultra-bold grotesque ("Money works") with a high-contrast italic serif ("better here."), and a phone mockup tilted ~8° on the right whose white dashboard UI — balance figure, area chart, account list — is the only fine detail on the card. Everything else is negative space, with no CTA or supporting copy, which keeps the card legible at thumbnail size.
